\[
\|\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}\| = \sqrt{(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}) \cdot (\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b})}
\]
and
\[
\|\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b}\| = \sqrt{(\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b}) \cdot (\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b})}
\]
Given that \(\|\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}\| = \|\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b}\|\), we can set the squares of the norms equal to each other:
\[
(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}) \cdot (\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}) = (\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b}) \cdot (\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{b})
